the science is still young and messy, and there’s not enough evidence for experts to settle on a 
consensus. In this scenario, be skeptical of anyone who claims to know the absolute truth or makes 
promises that seem too good to be true. We often see such claims in the field of nutrition, where 
book authors, podcasters, celebrity influencers, and companies selling products for a profit say 
they know the secrets of good health. They’re often operating in areas of scientific uncertainty, 
extrapolating from a few interesting findings, or outside of consensus entirely.
